why: Doc sentence is verbatim (curl of agent-sdk/typescript.md, the bullet list under 'Several fields on the result carry diagnostic detail beyond subtype'; neighbouring bullets do not reverse it). The identifier half of the finding is also true: event-adapter.ts:581-585 derives terminalReason from stop_reason==='refusal' then the 4-entry CLAUDE_RESULT_SUBTYPE_REASON table at :50-57 with an unrecognized-subtype fallback to 'provider_error', and `grep -ra terminal_reason` over packages/ and apps/ finds zero reads in source (only comments, tests and plans). The installed SDK 0.3.183 declares the field (sdk.d.ts:6333, 12 values) and the bundled native binary really emits it (`terminal_reason: Pr.value?.reason` on the result). The CONSEQUENCE, which is what was filed, is false in both halves of its own enumerated list. (1) Five of the eight named values -- prompt_too_long, image_error, model_error, blocking_limit, rapid_refill_breaker -- are, in the very binary we bundle, ALWAYS preceded by an assistant API-error message the loop yields before it returns the reason: `tc({content: ..., error: 'invalid_request'})` for prompt_too_long/image_error/blocking_limit/rapid_refill_breaker (blocking_limit's content is literally the constant OF="Prompt is too long") and `error:'rate_limit'` for the model_error arm, and the SDK forwards that code to the consumer (`yield {type:'assistant', ..., error: r.error}`). Our adapter consumes exactly that one layer up: event-adapter.ts:293-301 -> claude-agent.ts:2660 mapSDKErrorToTypedError -> claude-sdk-error-mapper.ts, which has a dedicated 'Context Window Exceeded' branch keyed on 'prompt is too long'/'context window' plus 'Rate Limit Exceeded' and an 'Invalid Request' fallback that already advises /compact. So the user gets a specific, actionable typed error card, not an undifferentiated provider error, and the premise 'the SDK put the specific cause on the same message' is wrong -- the cause arrives earlier, on a different message, and we do read it. This is the repo's documented recurring false positive: the identifier is unwired, the consequence is handled upstream. (2) The other three named values -- hook_stopped, stop_hook_prevented, aborted_tools -- sit in the binary's CLEAN-turn bucket (the reason switch routes completed/stop_hook_prevented/hook_stopped/tool_deferred/max_turns/aborted_streaming/aborted_tools to Ie('turn'), and only blocking_limit/rapid_refill_breaker/prompt_too_long/image_error/model_error to Oe('turn', reason)), and the result subtype is chosen by `Gmo(lastMessage, stop_reason)` -- the shape of the last message -- not by the reason at all. A hook_stopped or stop_hook_prevented turn whose last message is assistant text or a user tool_result block ends `subtype:'success'`, where our adapter emits NO terminal reason; it is never reported as 'provider_error'. Aborted_streaming/aborted_tools in this product are user-initiated stops that already carry AbortReason.UserStop/Redirect from our own abort path. (3) The '19-value vocabulary' is the current CLI's; the version we ship has 12 and lacks api_error, budget_exhausted, structured_output_retry_exhausted, tool_deferred_unavailable, turn_setup_failed, background_requested and malformed_tool_use_exhausted, so most of the claimed vocabulary is not readable today. (4) Mapping from the subtype rather than from terminal_reason is a recorded decision, not an oversight: docs/superpowers/plans/2026-07-28-structured-output.md:49 -- 'the docs, not the installed typings, are the contract for our own terminal vocabulary (we map from the SUBTYPE, not from the SDK's terminal_reason field)' -- and AgentTerminalReason is a deliberately unified cross-backend vocabulary pinned to AbortReason (packages/core/src/types/message.ts:910-948: 'this list deliberately mirrors it rather than introducing a second one'), not a mirror of Claude's enum. It is NOT one of the nine inert-worklist section 3 owner decisions, and not a de-brand/dropped-subscription product difference.
correctedState: Confirmed: packages/shared/src/agent/backend/claude/event-adapter.ts never reads msg.terminal_reason; it derives AgentTerminalReason from stop_reason==='refusal' (:581) then from the 4-entry subtype table (:50-57), collapsing unrecognized subtypes to 'provider_error'. But the filed consequence does not follow. In the bundled SDK 0.3.183 binary, every reason in the error bucket (prompt_too_long, image_error, model_error, blocking_limit, rapid_refill_breaker) is emitted only AFTER an assistant message carrying an SDKAssistantMessageError code ('invalid_request' or 'rate_limit') and human-readable content, and that message is already mapped to a specific typed AgentError by event-adapter.ts:293-301 -> claude-agent.ts:2660 -> claude-sdk-error-mapper.ts (Context Window Exceeded / Rate Limit Exceeded / Invalid Request with /compact advice). The reasons in the clean bucket (hook_stopped, stop_hook_prevented, aborted_streaming, aborted_tools, tool_deferred, max_turns, completed) do not force subtype 'error_during_execution' at all -- subtype is decided by Gmo(lastMessage, stop_reason) -- so a hook-stopped turn arrives as subtype 'success'. The residual, much smaller gap: on an actual error_during_execution result the complete event's terminalReason is the generic 'provider_error' and the error event's text is the SDK's '[ede_diagnostic] result_type=... stop_reason=...' line, and a hook_stopped/stop_hook_prevented success result is reported as an ordinary clean completion with no reason. That is model-visible/cosmetic detail loss, not the claimed user-facing undifferentiated provider error, and the installed enum offers 12 values, not 19.
